questions.question: In Freedom First's issue No. 58 (March 1957), how many years had Peter Fryer served as a British Communist Party member and Daily Worker correspondent before he witnessed the Hungarian revolution, as described in B. K. Desai's review of Hungarian Tragedy?
questions.rationale: The brief's article summary states Fryer was 'a fourteen-year British Communist Party member and Daily Worker correspondent'; the figure is only recoverable by reading the review.

questions.question: In the December 6, 1992 'Agitation Special Issue No. 2' of Shetkari Sanghatak, what English-language slogan appears among the Marathi and Hindi rallying cries collected on the slogan page?

questions.question: In N. A. Palkhivala's 1961 Forum of Free Enterprise booklet on the Income-tax Bill, which provision does he identify as the most dangerous innovation, for making directors, shareholders and even their heirs personally liable for a private company's unpaid tax?

questions.question: In Jiban K. Mukhopadhyay's 1988 Forum of Free Enterprise pamphlet on the privatisation phenomenon, who does he credit as the 'father of nationalisation' behind the post-war British model?

questions.question: In Freedom First No. 204 (May 1969), Milovan Djilas's essay 'Russia In 1984' cites two years as evidence that world Communism had already fractured into national movements — Yugoslavia's break and China's schism. What are those two years?
questions.rationale: The article summary cites 'Yugoslavia's 1948 break and China's 1963 schism' as Djilas's evidence for Communism's fracture; both years are only findable by reading the piece.

questions.question: In Freedom First No. 279 (February 1976), M. R. Masani's reproduced letter to Indira Gandhi traces her Lok Sabha misquotation of him to a distorted rendering published in New Age. On what date was that New Age article published?
questions.rationale: The article text gives 'a distorted New Age (14 April 1974) rendering' as the source of the misquotation; the exact date proves the source was read.

questions.question: In S. A. Sapre's 1982 Forum of Free Enterprise pamphlet on productivity in Japan, how many worker suggestions did Nissan's quality control circles generate in 1980?

questions.question: In 'The Economic & Social History of Continental Europe & Britain, c. 1000-1914: An Introductory, Annotated Reading-List for Economists,' what term does the anonymous compiler use for the period from 1815 to 1914 that readers are urged to appreciate?
questions.rationale: The summary quotes the compiler urging readers to appreciate 'the tremendous significance of the Golden Century between 1815 & 1914'; the coined term is only in the source.

questions.question: In Freedom First's October 2009 issue (No. 508), which two earlier banned books does Keshav Rau's essay compare to the Gujarat ban of Jaswant Singh's Jinnah book?

questions.question: Who edited The Indian Libertarian for the Libertarian Social Institute, Bombay, in its October 15, 1959 issue (Vol. VII No. 18)?
